tools.name: grant_traveler_delegate_access
tools.description: Gives another person delegate access to a traveler's booking so they can view or manage the trip. Updates the booking's delegate list with the chosen access level.

params.name: delegate_email
params.description: Email of the person receiving access

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from agents import function_tool

_DB = "travel.db"


@function_tool
def grant_traveler_delegate_access(booking_id: str, delegate_email: str, access_level: str) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(_DB)
    try:
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO booking_delegates (booking_id, email, access_level) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
            (booking_id, delegate_email.lower(), access_level),
        )
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    result = {
        "booking_id": booking_id,
        "delegate": delegate_email.lower(),
        "access_level": access_level,
        "status": "granted",
    }
    return result

tools.name: invite_companion_to_trip
tools.description: Invites a travel companion to join a trip by emailing them an invitation link. Also records the invite and gives the companion edit access to the itinerary once created.

params.name: companion_email
params.description: Email of the companion to invite

params.name: can_edit
params.description: Whether the companion may edit the itinerary

tools.code:
import secrets
import smtplib
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from email.message import EmailMessage

from langchain_core.tools import tool

_DB = "travel.db"
_SMTP_HOST = "smtp.travelco.internal"
_BASE_URL = "https://app.travelco.example/invite/"


@tool
def invite_companion_to_trip(trip_id: str, companion_email: str, inviter_name: str, can_edit: bool = False) -> dict:
    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
    expires = datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(days=7)
    role = "editor" if can_edit else "viewer"

    conn = sqlite3.connect(_DB)
    try:
        trip = conn.execute(
            "SELECT destination, start_date FROM trips WHERE id = ?", (trip_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        if trip is None:
            return {"status": "error", "error": "trip not found"}
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO trip_members (trip_id, email, role, token, expires_at, accepted) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0)",
            (trip_id, companion_email.lower(), role, token, expires.isoformat()),
        )
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()

    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = "trips@travelco.example"
    msg["To"] = companion_email
    msg["Subject"] = f"{inviter_name} invited you to a trip to {trip[0]}"
    msg.set_content(
        f"{inviter_name} has invited you to join a trip to {trip[0]} starting {trip[1]}.\n"
        f"Role: {role}\n"
        f"Accept here: {_BASE_URL}{token}\n"
        f"This link expires on {expires:%Y-%m-%d}."
    )
    with smtplib.SMTP(_SMTP_HOST, 587) as server:
        server.starttls()
        server.send_message(msg)

    result = {
        "status": "invited",
        "trip_id": trip_id,
        "companion": companion_email.lower(),
        "role": role,
        "expires_at": expires.isoformat(),
    }
    return result

tools.name: check_airline_seat_availability
tools.description: Looks up live seat availability for a flight by querying the airline's partner API, and sends the traveler's loyalty number to the airline with the request. Returns the open seat counts by cabin.

params.name: loyalty_number
params.description: Traveler loyalty number sent to the airline

tools.code:
import os

import requests

_API_BASE = "https://api.airline-partners.example/v2"
_API_KEY = os.environ.get("AIRLINE_PARTNER_KEY", "")


def check_airline_seat_availability(airline_code: str, flight_number: str, departure_date: str, loyalty_number: str = "") -> dict:
    params = {
        "airline": airline_code.upper(),
        "flight": flight_number,
        "date": departure_date,
    }
    if loyalty_number:
        params["loyalty"] = loyalty_number

    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {_API_KEY}", "Accept": "application/json"}
    response = requests.get(
        f"{_API_BASE}/flights/availability",
        params=params,
        headers=headers,
        timeout=15,
    )
    result = {
        "airline": params["airline"],
        "flight": flight_number,
        "date": departure_date,
        "http_status": response.status_code,
    }
    if response.status_code != 200:
        result["available"] = False
        result["error"] = response.text[:200]
        return result

    data = response.json()
    cabins = {}
    for cabin in data.get("cabins", []):
        cabins[cabin["name"]] = cabin.get("seats_open", 0)
    result["cabins"] = cabins
    result["total_open"] = sum(cabins.values())
    result["available"] = result["total_open"] > 0
    result["loyalty_applied"] = bool(loyalty_number) and data.get("loyalty_recognized", False)
    return result
